description: Check a Québec construction contractor against four official public data sources in one call: active RBQ licence (status, restrictions, bond, authorized work categories), RENA (businesses barred from public contracts and public subcontracts), environmental administrative penalties (MELCCFP) and public contracts awarded on SEAO (count, total amount, main public buyers, last 12 months). Returns a verdict ok / review / blocking / not_found with reasons, sources and extraction dates. Use when the user asks whether a Québec contractor, subcontractor or renovation company is licensed, trustworthy or eligible for public contracts. Provide neq, licence or name.
name: qc_contractor_check

public_contracts.description: Public contracts awarded on SEAO in the last 12 months: contracts, total_cad, first_award, last_award, buyers, by_category, recent (up to 5), matched_by

query.description: What was searched and how it matched

rbq.description: RBQ licence record: licence, neq, name, status, restriction, bond, municipality, subcategory_labels, candidates

verdict.description: ok = active licence, no RENA, no penalty; review = something to look at; blocking = RENA listing or no active licence; not_found = no match

title: Québec contractor check
